bayts.text: Upon the Chosen One (Muḥammad), from me, a blessing that guards every side of me from harm, just as he makes good reach toward me.
Upon the Elect (Muḥammad), from me, a greeting of peace that purifies my whole being, with the purification of a guide who has erased injustice.
Blessing and peace from Allah, forever, upon him who, through a Provider (Allah), makes my provisions pure for me.
Upon him through whom the Lord of creatures created the creatures, blessing and peace that endure, for me, as a visit.
From Allah, Lord of the Throne, I seek through him goodness, by the rank of the Messenger of Allah, he who has gladdened my breast.
Upon you be the blessing of Allah, then His peace, perpetually, just as (He) has made evil reach others than me.
Your manifest precedence has appeared to me and led to me a wondrous gift, which has surpassed every measure of the open and the secret.
From Allah seek for me that He, by His grace, make me a servant for you, O you who have spared me from the enemies, every one of them.
Upon you a blessing with peace from the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), with your Family and your Companions, those who have gathered goodness.
Upon you be the blessing of Allah, as long as aspirations yield to my whole being without guile, and as long as (He) gladdens my breast.
